soundness_flags.label: ass:augmented-scm-compatibility / def:model-class / thm:graphwise-sid-completeness
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited NeurIPS model defines G as the graph induced by the SCM (parent sets equal directed parents and a bidirected edge iff mechanisms share an exogenous variable), whereas the proposal calls a nonminimal permitted-edge supergraph with inactive listed edges the published class.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:executable-success-or-certificate
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Total success-or-certificate compilation is conditional on proving the effective inverse-lift constructor for every terminal failure.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Conditional compiler theorem: given the inverse-lift theorem, sID± is total with the stated rank and checker bounds; it is not an independent completeness claim.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines Pa_G(X)=Pa_X and puts X↔Y exactly when U_X∩U_Y is nonempty; it assumes independent exogenous variables and an induced augmented ADMG.
Algorithm 1 is stated sound and its completeness upon FAIL is explicitly conjectured.
The fully observed S-ID paper states necessary-and-sufficient graphical conditions and a sound-and-complete algorithm.
A hedge yields nonidentifiability via binary countermodels, and ID propagates FAIL with a hedge witness.
The paper proves a sound-and-complete c-gID algorithm and emphasizes positive completeness constructions, but studies Q[S] inputs rather than a sole selected observational law P(V|S=1).

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Resolve the model-class mismatch: either require every listed directed and bidirected edge to be induced exactly, matching the cited S-ID definition, or retag the permitted-edge/nonminimal class as novel and prove Algorithm 1 soundness and the claimed extension over that larger class.
Make the two-virtual-edge rational fiber calculation a concrete exhibited certificate or a proved constancy obstruction before retaining the universal inverse-lift headline.
State the graph-convention distinction in the theorem comparison and give an explicit reduction showing how any exact-graph requirement is met by the returned certificates.

recommended_next_step: Revise the ambient graph convention and headline before Stage 0; then pursue the displayed two-virtual-edge fiber calculation as the decisive gate for the inverse-lift route.
